card.name: Parenthesis after St. John's wort
card.fires_on: The opening parenthesis right after "St. John's wort" in drug interaction lists, just before the Latin name Hypericum perforatum.

modes.label: Latin name bracket
modes.description: An open parenthesis following St. John's wort in an interaction list, introducing the plant's Latin name.
modes.example: Herbal product: St. John's wort<< (>> Hypericum perforatum ) ↓ darun

card.writes: The promoted tokens (anti, Anti, Rev) are only loosely related, so there is no clear output effect beyond a weak push toward unusual prefixes.
card.plain: It marks the bracket that opens the Latin name after St. John's wort in lists of interacting herbal products.
